interpretation: The analytic Gaussian transport is materially stronger than CB11 and preserves luminance, hard-boundary and gradient safety on the development population.
Its stronger anisotropic chroma target requires a sub-half analytical safe step for a median 13.3331% of pixels, exceeding the frozen 10% maximum.
The result does not justify covariance regularization, eigenvalue clipping, threshold relaxation or blind review.
next_action: Retain AO6 as the colour incumbent and require a mechanism that predicts bounded transport strength before constructing an infeasible chroma target.
claim_ceiling: Stable negative development evidence for image-global Gaussian chroma transport; not stock response, calibration, population preference or product promotion.
